void emit(string text)
    println(text)

int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b

int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

bool has_text(string[] choices, string value)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == value
            return true
    return false

class Box(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)
class Rectangle(string name, string layer, Box box)
class Relation(nat kind, Box common, int ox, int oy, int gap, string direction)
class Span(int first, int last)
class Cell(int x, int y)
class Hole(int amount, Box bounds)
class Pair(Rectangle first, Rectangle second)
class Rule(string kind, string layer, string other, int value)
class Snapshot(map<string, Rectangle> rectangles, string command_line)

string box_text(Box box)
    return "({box.x1},{box.y1})-({box.x2},{box.y2})"

string point_text(int x, int y)
    return "({x},{y})"

int rectangle_width(Rectangle rect)
    return rect.box.x2 - rect.box.x1

int rectangle_height(Rectangle rect)
    return rect.box.y2 - rect.box.y1

int rectangle_area(Rectangle rect)
    return rectangle_width(rect) * rectangle_height(rect)

string name_list(Rectangle[] rects)
    return if #rects == 0 then "none" else [for rect := rects[] then rect.name].join(" ")

int minimum_margin(Rectangle outer, Rectangle inner)
    return minimum(minimum(inner.box.x1 - outer.box.x1, inner.box.y1 - outer.box.y1), minimum(outer.box.x2 - inner.box.x2, outer.box.y2 - inner.box.y2))

Relation relation(Rectangle a, Rectangle b)
    common := Box(maximum(a.box.x1, b.box.x1), maximum(a.box.y1, b.box.y1), minimum(a.box.x2, b.box.x2), minimum(a.box.y2, b.box.y2))
    ox := common.x2 - common.x1
    oy := common.y2 - common.y1
    nat kind := if ox > 0 and oy > 0 then 0 else (if ox < 0 or oy < 0 then 3 else (if ox == 0 and oy == 0 then 2 else 1))
    direction := if ox < 0 and oy < 0 then "diagonal" else (if ox < 0 then "x" else "y")
    return Relation(kind, common, ox, oy, maximum(0, maximum(-ox, -oy)), direction)

bool connected(Rectangle a, Rectangle b)
    return relation(a, b).kind <= 1

Box bounding_box(Rectangle[] rects)
    result := rects[0].box
    for rect := rects[]
        result.x1 = minimum(result.x1, rect.box.x1)
        result.y1 = minimum(result.y1, rect.box.y1)
        result.x2 = maximum(result.x2, rect.box.x2)
        result.y2 = maximum(result.y2, rect.box.y2)
    return result

int[] unique_ints(int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != value
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

nat int_index(int[] values, int value)
    for: i < #values
        if values[i] == value
            return i
    return #values

Span[] runs(bool[] flags, int[] coordinates)
    Span[] result := []
    nat i := 0
    while i < #flags
        if not flags[i]
            i += 1
            continue
        first := i
        while i < #flags and flags[i]
            i += 1
        result = result.append(Span(coordinates[first], coordinates[i]))
    return result

bool has_span(Span[] spans, Span value)
    for entry := spans[]
        if entry.first == value.first and entry.last == value.last
            return true
    return false

class Coverage(int[] xs, int[] ys, int[][] counts)
    int column_count()
        return int(#xs) - 1

    int row_count()
        return int(#ys) - 1

    bool covered(int i, int j)
        return i >= 0 and j >= 0 and i < column_count() and j < row_count() and counts[i][j] > 0

    int cell_area(int i, int j)
        return (xs[i + 1] - xs[i]) * (ys[j + 1] - ys[j])

    int area(threshold := 1)
        result := 0
        for: int i < column_count()
            for: int j < row_count()
                if counts[i][j] >= threshold
                    result += cell_area(i, j)
        return result

    int perimeter()
        result := 0
        for: int i <= column_count()
            for: int j < row_count()
                if covered(i - 1, j) != covered(i, j)
                    result += ys[j + 1] - ys[j]
        for: int j <= row_count()
            for: int i < column_count()
                if covered(i, j - 1) != covered(i, j)
                    result += xs[i + 1] - xs[i]
        return result

    Hole[] holes()
        seen := [for i := (0:<int(column_count()))[] then [for j := (0:<int(row_count()))[] then false]]
        Hole[] result := []
        for: int j < row_count()
            for: int i < column_count()
                if seen[i][j] or counts[i][j] > 0
                    continue
                pending := [Cell(i, j)]
                seen[i][j] = true
                boundary := false
                amount := 0
                bounds := Box(xs[i], ys[j], xs[i + 1], ys[j + 1])
                while #pending != 0
                    current := pending[-1]
                    pending = pending[:<#pending - 1]
                    x := current.x
                    y := current.y
                    boundary = boundary or x == 0 or y == 0 or x == column_count() - 1 or y == row_count() - 1
                    amount += cell_area(x, y)
                    bounds.x1 = minimum(bounds.x1, xs[x])
                    bounds.y1 = minimum(bounds.y1, ys[y])
                    bounds.x2 = maximum(bounds.x2, xs[x + 1])
                    bounds.y2 = maximum(bounds.y2, ys[y + 1])
                    for next := [Cell(x - 1, y), Cell(x + 1, y), Cell(x, y - 1), Cell(x, y + 1)][]
                        if next.x >= 0 and next.x < column_count() and next.y >= 0 and next.y < row_count() and not seen[next.x][next.y] and counts[next.x][next.y] == 0
                            seen[next.x][next.y] = true
                            pending = pending.append(next)
                if not boundary
                    result = result.append(Hole(amount, bounds))
        return result

    Box[] pieces()
        Span[][] row_runs := []
        for: int j < row_count()
            row_runs = row_runs.append(runs([for i := (0:<int(column_count()))[] then counts[i][j] > 0], xs))
        Box[] result := []
        for: j < #row_runs
            for span := row_runs[j][]
                if j > 0 and has_span(row_runs[j - 1], span)
                    continue
                top := j + 1
                while top < #row_runs and has_span(row_runs[top], span)
                    top += 1
                result = result.append(Box(span.first, ys[j], span.last, ys[top]))
        return result

    Box | none largest_empty()
        found := false
        best_area := 0
        best := Box(0, 0, 0, 0)
        for: int a < column_count()
            free := [for j := (0:<int(row_count()))[] then true]
            for: a + 1 <= int b <= column_count()
                for: int j < row_count()
                    free[j] = free[j] and counts[b - 1][j] == 0
                width := xs[b] - xs[a]
                for span := runs(free, ys)[]
                    amount := width * (span.last - span.first)
                    better := not found or amount > best_area
                    if found and amount == best_area
                        better = xs[a] < best.x1 or (xs[a] == best.x1 and (span.first < best.y1 or (span.first == best.y1 and width < best.x2 - best.x1)))
                    if better
                        found = true
                        best_area = amount
                        best = Box(xs[a], span.first, xs[b], span.last)
        return if found then best else none

Coverage make_coverage(Rectangle[] rects, int[] extra_xs := [], int[] extra_ys := [])
    xs := extra_xs
    ys := extra_ys
    for rect := rects[]
        xs = xs.append(rect.box.x1).append(rect.box.x2)
        ys = ys.append(rect.box.y1).append(rect.box.y2)
    xs = unique_ints(xs)
    ys = unique_ints(ys)
    counts := [for i := (0:<nat(#xs - 1))[] then [for j := (0:<nat(#ys - 1))[] then 0]]
    for rect := rects[]
        for: int_index(xs, rect.box.x1) <= i < int_index(xs, rect.box.x2)
            for: int_index(ys, rect.box.y1) <= j < int_index(ys, rect.box.y2)
                counts[i][j] += 1
    return Coverage(xs, ys, counts)

Rectangle[][] find_nets(Rectangle[] rects)
    seen := [for i := (nat(0):<#rects)[] then false]
    Rectangle[][] result := []
    for: start < #rects
        if seen[start]
            continue
        pending := [start]
        seen[start] = true
        included := [for i := (nat(0):<#rects)[] then false]
        while #pending != 0
            current := pending[-1]
            pending = pending[:<#pending - 1]
            included[current] = true
            for: i < #rects
                if not seen[i] and connected(rects[current], rects[i])
                    seen[i] = true
                    pending = pending.append(i)
        Rectangle[] group := []
        for: i < #rects
            if included[i]
                group = group.append(rects[i])
        result = result.append(group)
    return result

string[] overlap_lines(Rectangle[] rects)
    string[] result := []
    for: i < #rects
        for: i + 1 <= j < #rects
            a := rects[i]
            b := rects[j]
            current := relation(a, b)
            if current.kind == 0
                result = result.append(a.name + " " + b.name + " " + box_text(current.common) + " area {current.ox * current.oy}")
    return result

class Violation(int gap, string first, string second, string direction)

string[] spacing_lines(Rectangle[] rects, int spacing)
    Violation[] found := []
    for: i < #rects
        for: i + 1 <= j < #rects
            current := relation(rects[i], rects[j])
            if current.kind != 2 and not (current.kind == 3 and current.gap < spacing)
                continue
            entry := Violation(current.gap, rects[i].name, rects[j].name, if current.kind == 2 then "corner" else current.direction)
            nat at := 0
            while at < #found and found[at].gap <= entry.gap
                at += 1
            found = found[:<at].append(entry).concat(found[at:])
    return [for entry := found[] then entry.first + " " + entry.second + " gap {entry.gap} " + entry.direction]

string percentage(int amount, int denominator)
    hundredths := 10000 * amount / denominator
    return "{hundredths / 100}.{hundredths % 100:02.}"

void report(string heading, string[] lines)
    emit(heading)
    for line := lines[]
        emit(line)

class Layout()
    rect_table := map<string, Rectangle>()
    rule_table := map<string, Rule>()
    Snapshot[] history := []

    Rectangle[] all_rects()
        Rectangle[] result := []
        for name := rect_table.keys().sorted()[]
            match rect_table.get(name)
                Rectangle value
                    result = result.append(value)
                none
                    void
        return result

    string[] layer_names()
        string[] result := []
        for rect := all_rects()[]
            if not has_text(result, rect.layer)
                result = result.append(rect.layer)
        return result.sorted()

    Rectangle[] on_layer(string layer)
        Rectangle[] result := []
        for rect := all_rects()[]
            if rect.layer == layer
                result = result.append(rect)
        return result

    Rectangle[] | error require_layer(string layer)
        Rectangle[] result := on_layer(layer)
        if #result == 0
            return error("no rectangles on " + layer)
        return result

    Rectangle | error get_rect(string name)
        match rect_table.get(name)
            Rectangle value
                return value
            none
                return error("unknown rectangle " + name)

    void | error unused(string name)
        match rect_table.get(name)
            Rectangle value
                return error("duplicate rectangle " + name)
            none
                void
        return void

    Pair | error get_pair(string a, string b)
        Rectangle first := try get_rect(a)
        Rectangle second := try get_rect(b)
        if a == b
            return error("same rectangle " + a)
        return Pair(first, second)

    void | error .place(Rectangle rect)
        if absolute(rect.box.x1) > 10000 or absolute(rect.box.y1) > 10000 or absolute(rect.box.x2) > 10000 or absolute(rect.box.y2) > 10000
            return error("out of bounds")
        .rect_table.set(rect.name, rect)
        return void

    string[] rule_violations(Rule rule)
        Rectangle[] rects := on_layer(rule.layer)
        if rule.kind == "spacing"
            return spacing_lines(rects, rule.value)
        string[] result := []
        for rect := rects[]
            if rule.kind == "width"
                size := minimum(rectangle_width(rect), rectangle_height(rect))
                if size < rule.value
                    result = result.append(rect.name + " width {size}")
            else
                Rectangle[] outers := on_layer(rule.other)
                found := false
                best := 0
                for outer := outers[]
                    value := minimum_margin(outer, rect)
                    if not found or value > best
                        best = value
                        found = true
                if not found or best < rule.value
                    result = result.append(rect.name + " best margin " + (if found then string(best) else "none"))
        return result

    void | error .execute(string line)
        parts := line.split(" ")
        command := parts[0]
        args := parts[1:]
        before := rect_table
        if command == "ADD"
            name := args[0]
            layer := args[1]
            try unused(name)
            bounds := Box(int(args[2]), int(args[3]), int(args[4]), int(args[5]))
            if bounds.x1 >= bounds.x2 or bounds.y1 >= bounds.y2
                return error("invalid rectangle")
            try .place(Rectangle(name, layer, bounds))
            emit("added " + name + " " + layer + " " + box_text(bounds))
        elif has_text(["COPY", "MOVE", "RESIZE", "SPLIT", "LAYER", "DELETE"], command)
            name := args[0]
            Rectangle rect := try get_rect(name)
            bounds := rect.box
            if command == "COPY" or command == "MOVE"
                new_name := if command == "COPY" then args[1] else name
                nat offset := if command == "COPY" then 2 else 1
                if command == "COPY"
                    try unused(new_name)
                dx := int(args[offset])
                dy := int(args[offset + 1])
                moved := Box(bounds.x1 + dx, bounds.y1 + dy, bounds.x2 + dx, bounds.y2 + dy)
                try .place(Rectangle(new_name, rect.layer, moved))
                emit(if command == "COPY" then "copied " + name + " to " + new_name + " " + box_text(moved) else "moved " + name + " to " + box_text(moved))
            elif command == "RESIZE"
                width := int(args[1])
                height := int(args[2])
                if width <= 0 or height <= 0
                    return error("invalid size")
                bounds.x2 = bounds.x1 + width
                bounds.y2 = bounds.y1 + height
                try .place(Rectangle(name, rect.layer, bounds))
                emit("resized " + name + " to " + box_text(bounds))
            elif command == "SPLIT"
                axis := args[1]
                position := int(args[2])
                new_name := args[3]
                try unused(new_name)
                if (axis == "x" and not (bounds.x1 < position and position < bounds.x2)) or (axis == "y" and not (bounds.y1 < position and position < bounds.y2))
                    return error("cut outside " + name)
                kept := bounds
                piece := bounds
                if axis == "x"
                    kept.x2 = position
                    piece.x1 = position
                else
                    kept.y2 = position
                    piece.y1 = position
                .rect_table.set(name, Rectangle(name, rect.layer, kept))
                .rect_table.set(new_name, Rectangle(new_name, rect.layer, piece))
                emit("split " + name + " at " + axis + "={position}: " + name + " " + box_text(kept) + ", " + new_name + " " + box_text(piece))
            elif command == "LAYER"
                layer := args[1]
                if layer == rect.layer
                    return error("already on " + layer)
                .rect_table.set(name, Rectangle(name, layer, bounds))
                emit("layer " + name + " " + rect.layer + " -> " + layer)
            else
                .rect_table.remove(name)
                emit("deleted " + name)
        elif command == "UNDO"
            if #history == 0
                return error("nothing to undo")
            last := history[-1]
            history = history[:<#history - 1]
            rect_table = last.rectangles
            emit("undo: " + last.command_line)
        elif command == "LIST"
            Rectangle[] rects := all_rects()
            report("rectangles: {#rects}", [for rect := rects[] then rect.name + " " + rect.layer + " " + box_text(rect.box) + " {rectangle_width(rect)}x{rectangle_height(rect)}"])
        elif command == "INFO"
            name := args[0]
            Rectangle rect := try get_rect(name)
            emit(name + " " + rect.layer + " " + box_text(rect.box) + " {rectangle_width(rect)}x{rectangle_height(rect)} area {rectangle_area(rect)}")
            Rectangle[] others := []
            for other := all_rects()[]
                if other.name != name
                    others = others.append(other)
            labels := ["overlaps", "touches", "corners"]
            for: nat kind < 3
                Rectangle[] found := []
                for other := others[]
                    if other.layer == rect.layer and relation(rect, other).kind == kind
                        found = found.append(other)
                emit(labels[kind] + ": " + name_list(found))
            Rectangle[] enclosed := []
            Rectangle[] enclosing := []
            for other := others[]
                if minimum_margin(rect, other) >= 0
                    enclosed = enclosed.append(other)
                if minimum_margin(other, rect) >= 0
                    enclosing = enclosing.append(other)
            emit("encloses: " + name_list(enclosed))
            emit("enclosed by: " + name_list(enclosing))
        elif command == "LAYERS"
            string[] layers := layer_names()
            emit("layers: {#layers}")
            for layer := layers[]
                Rectangle[] rects := on_layer(layer)
                emit(layer + ": {#rects} rectangles, area {make_coverage(rects).area()}, nets {#find_nets(rects)}")
        elif command == "OVERLAPS"
            string[] lines := []
            if #args == 0
                for layer := layer_names()[]
                    for entry := overlap_lines(on_layer(layer))[]
                        lines = lines.append(layer + " " + entry)
                report("overlaps all layers: {#lines}", lines)
            else
                lines = overlap_lines(try require_layer(args[0]))
                report("overlaps " + args[0] + ": {#lines}", lines)
        elif has_text(["INTERSECT", "ADJACENT", "ENCLOSE", "PATH"], command)
            a := args[0]
            b := args[1]
            Pair pair := try get_pair(a, b)
            first := pair.first
            second := pair.second
            current := relation(first, second)
            if command == "INTERSECT"
                detail := ""
                if current.kind == 0
                    detail = box_text(current.common) + " area {current.ox * current.oy}"
                elif current.kind == 1
                    detail = "segment " + box_text(current.common) + " length {current.ox + current.oy}"
                elif current.kind == 2
                    detail = "point " + point_text(current.common.x1, current.common.y1)
                else
                    detail = "none, gap {current.gap}"
                emit("intersect " + a + " " + b + ": " + detail)
            elif command == "ADJACENT"
                detail := ""
                if current.kind == 0
                    detail = "overlapping"
                elif current.kind == 1
                    side := if current.ox == 0 then (if first.box.x2 == current.common.x1 then "west" else "east") else (if first.box.y2 == current.common.y1 then "south" else "north")
                    detail = a + " is " + side + " of " + b + ", edge " + box_text(current.common) + ", length {current.ox + current.oy}"
                elif current.kind == 2
                    detail = "corner only at " + point_text(current.common.x1, current.common.y1)
                else
                    detail = "not adjacent"
                emit("adjacent " + a + " " + b + ": " + detail)
            elif command == "ENCLOSE"
                left := second.box.x1 - first.box.x1
                bottom := second.box.y1 - first.box.y1
                right := first.box.x2 - second.box.x2
                top := first.box.y2 - second.box.y2
                smallest := minimum_margin(first, second)
                detail := "margins left {left} bottom {bottom} right {right} top {top}"
                emit("enclose " + a + " " + b + ": " + (if smallest >= 0 then "yes, " + detail + ", min {smallest}" else "no, " + detail))
            else
                if first.layer != second.layer
                    return error("different layers")
                Rectangle[] rects := on_layer(first.layer)
                distances := [for i := (nat(0):<#rects)[] then -1]
                nat start := 0
                nat destination := 0
                for: i < #rects
                    if rects[i].name == a
                        start = i
                    if rects[i].name == b
                        destination = i
                queue := [destination]
                distances[destination] = 0
                nat at := 0
                while at < #queue
                    index := queue[at]
                    at += 1
                    for: i < #rects
                        if distances[i] < 0 and connected(rects[index], rects[i])
                            distances[i] = distances[index] + 1
                            queue = queue.append(i)
                if distances[start] < 0
                    emit("path " + a + " " + b + ": none")
                else
                    path := [a]
                    index := start
                    while index != destination
                        for: i < #rects
                            if distances[i] == distances[index] - 1 and connected(rects[index], rects[i])
                                index = i
                                path = path.append(rects[i].name)
                                break
                    emit("path " + a + " " + b + ": " + path.join(" -> ") + " ({#path - 1} steps)")
        elif command == "AT"
            x := int(args[0])
            y := int(args[1])
            string[] found := []
            for rect := all_rects()[]
                Box bounds := rect.box
                if bounds.x1 <= x and x <= bounds.x2 and bounds.y1 <= y and y <= bounds.y2
                    on_x := x == bounds.x1 or x == bounds.x2
                    on_y := y == bounds.y1 or y == bounds.y2
                    position := if on_x and on_y then "corner" else (if on_x or on_y then "edge" else "inside")
                    found = found.append(rect.name + " " + rect.layer + " " + position)
            emit("at " + point_text(x, y) + ": " + (if #found == 0 then "none" else found.join(", ")))
        elif command == "NEAREST"
            Rectangle rect := try get_rect(args[0])
            closest := ""
            best_gap := 0
            for other := on_layer(rect.layer)[]
                if other.name == rect.name
                    continue
                gap := relation(rect, other).gap
                if closest == "" or gap < best_gap
                    best_gap = gap
                    closest = other.name
            emit("nearest " + rect.name + ": " + (if closest == "" then "none" else closest + " gap {best_gap}"))
        elif command == "RULE"
            kind := if args[0] == "ENCLOSE" then "enclose" else (if args[0] == "SPACING" then "spacing" else "width")
            layer := args[1]
            other := if kind == "enclose" then args[2] else ""
            value := int(args[-1])
            if kind == "enclose" and layer == other
                return error("same layer " + layer)
            .rule_table.set(kind + " " + layer + " " + other, Rule(kind, layer, other, value))
            emit("rule " + kind + " " + args[1:].join(" "))
        elif command == "CHECK"
            keys := rule_table.keys().sorted()
            if #keys == 0
                return error("no rules")
            nat total := 0
            for key := keys[]
                match rule_table.get(key)
                    Rule rule
                        string[] lines := rule_violations(rule)
                        heading := rule.kind + " " + rule.layer + (if rule.kind == "enclose" then " " + rule.other else "") + " {rule.value}"
                        report(heading + ": {#lines} violations", lines)
                        total += #lines
                    none
                        void
            emit("check: {total} violations in {#keys} rules")
        else
            int threshold := if command == "COVER" then int(args[0]) else 1
            layer := args[if command == "COVER" then 1 else 0]
            Rectangle[] rects := try require_layer(layer)
            if command == "DRC"
                spacing := int(args[1])
                lines := spacing_lines(rects, spacing)
                report("drc " + layer + " spacing {spacing}: {#lines} violations", lines)
            elif command == "NETS"
                groups := find_nets(rects)
                emit("nets " + layer + ": {#groups}")
                for: i < #groups
                    emit("net {i + 1}: " + name_list(groups[i]) + " area {make_coverage(groups[i]).area()}")
            elif command == "RENDER"
                bounds := Box(int(args[1]), int(args[2]), int(args[3]), int(args[4]))
                if bounds.x1 >= bounds.x2 or bounds.y1 >= bounds.y2
                    return error("invalid window")
                if bounds.x2 - bounds.x1 > 60 or bounds.y2 - bounds.y1 > 40
                    return error("window too large")
                emit("render " + layer + " " + box_text(bounds))
                for: bounds.y2 > y >= bounds.y1
                    row := ""
                    for: bounds.x1 <= x < bounds.x2
                        nat count := 0
                        for rect := rects[]
                            if rect.box.x1 <= x and x < rect.box.x2 and rect.box.y1 <= y and y < rect.box.y2
                                count += 1
                        row += if count == 0 then "." else (if count < 10 then string(count) else "*")
                    emit(row)
            elif command == "BBOX" or command == "DENSITY"
                bounds := bounding_box(rects)
                width := bounds.x2 - bounds.x1
                height := bounds.y2 - bounds.y1
                if command == "BBOX"
                    emit("bbox " + layer + ": " + box_text(bounds) + " {width}x{height}, {#rects} rectangles, density " + percentage(make_coverage(rects).area(), width * height) + "%")
                else
                    window := int(args[1])
                    nc := (width + window - 1) / window
                    nr := (height + window - 1) / window
                    if nc > 20 or nr > 20
                        return error("too many windows")
                    coverage := make_coverage(rects, [for i := (0:<(int(nc) + 1))[] then bounds.x1 + i * window], [for j := (0:<(int(nr) + 1))[] then bounds.y1 + j * window])
                    tiles := [for i := (0:<int(nc))[] then [for j := (0:<int(nr))[] then 0]]
                    for: i < coverage.column_count()
                        for: j < coverage.row_count()
                            if coverage.counts[i][j] > 0
                                a := (coverage.xs[i] - bounds.x1) / window
                                b := (coverage.ys[j] - bounds.y1) / window
                                tiles[a][b] += coverage.cell_area(i, j)
                    denominator := window * window
                    emit("density " + layer + " window {window}: {nc}x{nr}")
                    for: nr > j >= 0
                        emit([for i := (0:<int(nc))[] then string(100 * tiles[i][j] / denominator)].join(" "))
                    for label := ["min", "max"][]
                        best := tiles[0][0]
                        best_i := 0
                        best_j := 0
                        for: j < nr
                            for: i < nc
                                if (label == "min" and tiles[i][j] < best) or (label == "max" and tiles[i][j] > best)
                                    best = tiles[i][j]
                                    best_i = i
                                    best_j = j
                        emit(label + " " + percentage(best, denominator) + "% at " + point_text(bounds.x1 + best_i * window, bounds.y1 + best_j * window))
            else
                coverage := make_coverage(rects)
                if command == "AREA"
                    emit("area " + layer + ": {coverage.area()}")
                elif command == "COVER"
                    emit("cover " + layer + " >= {threshold}: {coverage.area(threshold)}")
                elif command == "PERIMETER"
                    emit("perimeter " + layer + ": {coverage.perimeter()}")
                elif command == "EMPTY"
                    match coverage.largest_empty()
                        Box bounds
                            amount := (bounds.x2 - bounds.x1) * (bounds.y2 - bounds.y1)
                            emit("empty " + layer + ": " + box_text(bounds) + " area {amount}")
                        none
                            emit("empty " + layer + ": none")
                elif command == "HOLES"
                    found := coverage.holes()
                    emit("holes " + layer + ": {#found}")
                    for: i < #found
                        emit("hole {i + 1}: area {found[i].amount}, bbox " + box_text(found[i].bounds))
                elif command == "MERGE"
                    pieces := coverage.pieces()
                    report("merge " + layer + ": {#pieces} pieces", [for piece := pieces[] then box_text(piece)])
        if has_text(["ADD", "COPY", "MOVE", "RESIZE", "SPLIT", "LAYER", "DELETE"], command)
            history = history.append(Snapshot(before, line))
        return void

void run_program()
    line := ""
    scan(&line)
    count := nat(line)
    workbench := Layout()
    for: i < count
        scan(&line)
        match .workbench.execute(line)
            error failure
                emit("error: " + failure.message)
            void
                void

run_program()
